item.title: Puerto Rico port concessionaire bond outlook lowered by S&P
item.description: S&P revised its outlook to negative on San Juan Cruise Port LLC's BBB-minus rated bonds.

item.title: Austin OKs $1.4 billion of bonds for airport expansion
item.description: The airport system revenue bonds will finance portions of an estimated $5 billion expansion program at Austin Bergstrom International Airport.

item.title: Muni yields tick down, sizable inflows continue
item.description: Investors added $1.029 billion to municipal bond mutual funds in the week ended Wednesday, following $1.269 billion of inflows the prior week, according to LSEG Lipper data. This is the seventh time in eight weeks that inflows have topped $1 billion.

item.title: Los Angeles utility lawsuits underscore climate liability risk
item.description: Lawsuits against the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power over wildfire liability crystalize the need for state governments to take the lead, said MMA's Matt Fabian.

item.title: Brokers face FINRA claims in Easterly high-yield sell off
item.description: The fund plans to liquidate remaining assets, although a class-action lawsuit may delay final distributions.

item.title: Two more cities cancel elections on exiting Dallas transit agency
item.description: The Texas cities of Irving and Farmers Branch joined Plano in calling off May elections on withdrawing from Dallas Area Rapid Transit.

item.title: Guam GOs upgraded to BB by S&P
item.description: The ratings agency cited improved operating performance.

item.title: Tribes cheer House bill
item.description: Native American Tribes get a step closer to issuing more tax-exempt bonds as a bipartisan bill that would boost tax parity moves forward in the House while serving as companion legislation to a Senate version.

item.title: California treasurer urges Trump to honor SCOTUS tariff ruling
item.description: California and nine states' financial officers urged President Trump to honor the Supreme Court's ruling striking down his tariffs, citing harm to state budgets and the need for economic predictability.

item.title: Munis see small gains, 10-year UST falls below 4%
item.description: On the week, the muni market performed well, with most investor action happening in the longer half of the curve, said BofA strategists.
